1.text: “This could be a spaceship,” Chike said. The empty box was almost as tall as he was, and he could already picture it zooming into the sky.

2.text: He found the box beside the recycling bin. Mateo looked at the sunny backyard. “Or a flying machine,” he said. They taped on wings and named it The Sky Spark.

3.text: Chike climbed in and pushed off with his feet. The box tipped gently into the grass. The wings folded.

4.text: “Our first test taught us something,” Mateo said, holding up a bent wing. “The wings need more support.” Chike nodded. “Then let’s make them stronger.”

5.text: They built a wider base, added cardboard braces, and tested every piece. The Sky Spark did not truly fly, but it rolled beautifully down the hill.

7.text: What Chike and Mateo learned “We did not make a flying box,” Chike said. “We made a better idea.”

8.text: The End What will you create next?
